room_rent.note: Policy wording covers room rent and boarding expenses under in-patient treatment but no specific cap or category is mentioned in the schedule of benefits.

icu.note: ICU is listed as a covered in-patient expense but no specific cap is mentioned.

copayment.note: No mandatory co-payment mentioned in the policy wording.

sub_limits.note: No disease-wise sub-limits found. Only the ambulance benefit is capped at ₹2,000 per hospitalisation.

deductible.note: Deductible options: ₹1,00,000; ₹2,00,000; ₹3,00,000; ₹4,00,000; ₹5,00,000. Applies per hospitalisation except for Any One Illness.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; not applicable for accidents.

ped_waiting.note: Pre-existing diseases covered after 36 months of continuous coverage.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Specified diseases/procedures (e.g. cataract, hernia, joint replacement) excluded for 24 months.

maternity.note: Maternity is a standard permanent exclusion (Excl18). Ectopic pregnancy is covered.

cumulative_bonus.note: No cumulative/no-claim bonus mentioned in the policy wording or schedule of benefits.

restoration.note: No restoration or reset benefit mentioned in the policy wording.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for up to 60 days before admission.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for up to 90 days after discharge.

day_care.note: Day care procedures covered; defined as procedures under anaesthesia in less than 24 hours due to technological advancement.

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary treatment covered when hospitalisation is not possible on medical advice; condition must continue for at least 3 days.

ayush.note: AYUSH in-patient treatment covered in recognised AYUSH hospitals. Out-patient AYUSH not covered.

organ_donor.note: Organ donor harvesting expenses covered; donor pre/post expenses not covered.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance reimbursement capped at ₹2,000 per hospitalisation.

modern_treatments.note: Modern/robotic treatments not specifically mentioned in the policy wording.

consumables.note: Non-medical consumables (gloves, masks, etc.) are explicitly excluded per the Non-Medical Expenses annexure.

global_cover.note: Policy explicitly states coverage is only for medical treatment taken within India.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage, no claim can be contested except on grounds of established fraud.

grace_period.note: Grace period is 15 days for monthly premium mode and 30 days for all other modes.

free_look.note: Free look period of 30 days from date of receipt of policy document; applicable on new policies only.

portability.note: Portability allowed as per IRDAI guidelines; apply at least 30 days before renewal.

notable_exclusions.display: Maternity, congenital external anomalies, stem cell harvesting, dental (OPD), hearing aids, spectacles, alopecia, OPD treatment

optional_riders.display: Deductible waiver option (age 58–60, converts to ₹5L indemnity policy without deductible)
